sentences.text: A recovery response begins when a position discrepancy, obstruction, or safety alarm makes continued automatic movement uncertain.
Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller retain authority to stop or restrict movement whenever their safety status requires it.
Safety Zone Controller establishes a controlled boundary around the affected aisle and prevents new equipment from entering it.
Warehouse Operations Supervisor verifies that personnel are clear of the boundary before authorizing recovery work.
Conveyor Line Controller holds transfers that could feed material into the isolated area.
Morrowglass, the Warehouse Management System, receives the occupancy snapshot for recovery planning.
Warehouse Management System reconciles its location records with available sensor data before it presents a recovery plan.
Velvetrook applies the yard exception by holding affected vehicle movements outside the recovery boundary.
Yard traffic remains under controlled access until the aisle is confirmed safe for normal operations.
The recovery plan identifies the permitted travel envelope, the expected stopping point, and the conditions that require an immediate stop.
South Aisle Stacker Crane performs a controlled recovery maneuver at reduced speed within the isolated aisle.
The maneuver uses only the travel needed to reach a stable position or clear the obstruction under review.
Personnel remain outside the crane travel envelope throughout the maneuver.
A spotter may observe from a protected location but does not enter the isolated aisle while motion is enabled.
Any unexpected movement, loss of position confidence, or renewed alarm causes an immediate stop and reassessment.
Safety Zone Controller maintains the boundary until the cause of the stop has been understood and the recovery plan has been checked again.
Inbound Pallet Buffer remains unavailable to new receipts when its access path intersects the isolated area.
East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor remain stopped where their movement could compromise the boundary.
Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives a hold instruction for routes that approach the recovery area.
Maintenance Release Terminal records the inspection outcome and any repair work required before equipment can return to service.
Warehouse Operations Supervisor reconciles outstanding exceptions, maintenance holds, and access constraints before releasing normal work.
A controlled test confirms that the equipment responds correctly to stop commands and that its reported position is stable.
The isolation boundary is removed only after the test passes and the aisle is clear of personnel and loose material.
Normal transfers resume in stages, with the first movements observed for unexpected interference or renewed alarms.
